PORT.description: Web UI port. Railway maps this to the public domain.

SFTPGO_SFTPD__BINDINGS__0__ADDRESS.description: Bind address for the SFTP server.

SFTPGO_HTTPD__BINDINGS__0__ADDRESS.description: Bind address for the Web UI.

SFTPGO_HTTPD__TOKEN_VALIDATION.description: Web CSRF/JWT token validation mode. Required: 1 (no IP binding) behind Railway's reverse proxy, otherwise login fails with 'The form token is not valid' (sftpgo #1816).

SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__DRIVER.description: Data provider: sqlite (single instance), mysql, postgresql, cockroachdb, bbolt, memory.

SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__NAME.description: SQLite database file path. Keep on the volume (/var/lib/sftpgo) so data persists across deploys.

SFTPGO_LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level. Options: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR.
